hypotheses: H1: Second-line activity is driven by lineage-specific target dependence; e.g., ADRB2 in melanoma vs kidney, AVPR in kidney, ERBB2 in ER+ breast, PI3K in PTEN-mutant prostate/colorectal. Choose lines matching target expression.

H2: Second-line activity is dominated by shared L1000 systematic/vehicle-threshold response, so any line yields similar active/inactive calls; choose lines maximizing independent perturbation coverage rather than target rationale.
